author: reek
body: Relational algebra intermediate representation. Query expressions desugar to a tree of RelOp nodes. The executor walks this tree using the volcano iterator model.

author: reek
body: RelEquiJoin is the equality join on a list of named columns from each side, paired positionally: the first left column must equal the first right column, the second the second, and onward. A single-column join carries singleton lists. Predicates compare a column against a literal, never against another column, therefore RelJoin cannot express an equi-join between two relations; RelEquiJoin carries the column lists directly and the executor delegates to the hash join. Merged rows keep every column from both sides, duplicate names included, and a lookup by name finds the left occurrence first -- project immediately after joining. RelDerive appends one computed ColInteger column per DeriveSpec to every row of its child and passes the child's own columns through untouched.

author: reek
body: rel-equi-label renders an equi-join's column pairing as the comma separated left list, an equals sign, and the comma separated right list, therefore a singleton join renders exactly as the one-column form always did. rel-derive-label renders a derive as the comma separated list of its computed aliases, so a plan display names what the derive adds without repeating the source columns.
